ScaleConfig.description: Typed immutable configuration for one scale run. No hidden global config.

allocation.description: Frozen family allocation weights {A: x, B: 1-x}. Never optimized.

f_total_pct.description: TOTAL portfolio base risk fraction. Event fraction = family_weight * f_total_pct / 100.

gross_heat_cap_mult.description: H1 gross-cap multiplier RELATIVE TO f_total; cap scales linearly with f_total. None == H0 unconstrained diagnostic.

compounding.historical: overlap-exact hourly geometric compounding (frozen R6 primitive)
compounding.monte_carlo: per-path cumprod(1 + f_total * admitted_w * r) on the frozen R6 path layout
compounding.insolvency: paths with equity <= 0 flagged INSOLVENT_PATH, never clipped
